approved: Financial Sector Reform (Hayne Royal Commission Response No. 3) Bill 2021

The Financial Sector Reform (Hayne Royal Commission Response No. 3) Bill 2021 establishes a compensation scheme of last resort (CSLR) for consumers with unpaid Australian Financial Complaints Authority determinations, capped at $150,000, and makes amendments to support the new Financial Accountability Regime and transitional arrangements from the Banking Executive Accountability Regime.
